name: TASK-0197 assistant 말풍선 소요시간 표시 검증

steps.script: (function() { var items = document.querySelectorAll('.conversation-item, [data-conv-id]'); return { conversationCount: items.length, firstId: items.length > 0 ? (items[0].dataset.convId || items[0].getAttribute('data-conv-id')) : null }; })()
steps.label: conversation_list_check

steps.script: (function() { var metas = document.querySelectorAll('.message-meta'); var found = []; metas.forEach(function(m) { var dur = m.querySelector('.message-meta-duration'); var isAssistant = !!(m.closest('.message.is-assistant') || m.closest('[class*="assistant"]')); found.push({ snippet: m.textContent.trim().substring(0,80), hasDuration: !!dur, durationText: dur ? dur.textContent : null, isAssistant: isAssistant }); }); return { totalMeta: metas.length, withDuration: found.filter(function(f){return f.hasDuration;}).length, assistantMessages: found.filter(function(f){return f.isAssistant;}).length, samples: found.slice(0,5) }; })()
steps.label: duration_span_check
